hero.label: About us
hero.title: We assess the car, not the seller's interests
hero.subtitle: checkauto.lt is an independent vehicle-inspection service. We do not work for dealerships, sellers, or listing platforms.

values.heading: What an independent assessment means to us
values.v1_text: Our fee does not depend on whether you buy the vehicle.
values.v2_text: We explain defects in plain language and include them in a photo report.
values.v3_text: We assess every car consistently, regardless of make, price, or seller.

method.title: You make the decision. Our job is to show you the car's real condition.
method.item1_text: We travel to the seller, car lot, or service centre.
method.item2_text: Mechanical, body, electronic, and usage signals are considered together.
method.item3_text: We separate minor issues from risks that matter to price and safety.

cta.title: Have a car you want inspected?
cta.text: Book online or contact us by phone.
